metadata.title: पालघर हत्याकांड को कैसे समझें | Truth of Sadhus killing in Palghar
metadata.description: The brutal killing of two sadhus in a tribal village of Palghar district of Maharashtra is now attached to the identity of this district. A vigilante group killed them because they were wrongly identified as the members of a gang of child lifters. Later it was established that both were Sadhus, and were on their way to the funeral of their Guru in Gujarat. The Main Bhi Bharat team recently travelled through the tribal areas of Palghar district. While traveling through the Tansa national park jungle, our team unknowingly fell into a situation similar to what happened in April 2020 with the two Sadhus.
